message:
Fixed: yen receipts now show `Paid ¥500 by card` instead of `¥5.00`. `npm test` passes, 18 of 18.

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, but yen has no minor unit. I added a small set of currencies without a minor unit, currently just `JPY`, and `formatMoney` skips the division for them.

The helper is shared, so yen amounts on invoices (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) change the same way. The tests cover only the receipt case, so I didn't run those two against yen.
